description: What modelled objects (ids: shapes, groups, components, models brought in) are when the project goes to IFC, as SketchUp's Classifier: ifc_class IfcBeam, IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcChimney, IfcColumn, IfcCovering, IfcCurtainWall, IfcElectricAppliance, IfcFooting, IfcFurniture, IfcGeographicElement, IfcLightFixture, IfcMember, IfcPlate, IfcRailing, IfcRamp, IfcRoof, IfcSanitaryTerminal, IfcShadingDevice, IfcSlab, IfcStair or IfcWall (null clears it), and type its kind in words (e.g. Glass balustrade). A classified group goes out as one element. Walls, doors and the other elements have their classes already.
name: set_ifc_class
title: Classify objects for IFC
